title: Sea buckthorn flavonoid IGRh and its metabolites delay Caenorhabditis elegans aging via SIR-2.1/DAF-16-mediated IIS and autophagy-lysosomal pathways.
authors: Zhao, Jinmei; Dong, Wenxia; Wei, Juan; Jiang, Yumei; Deng, Zeqiang; Zubarev, Yury A; Bi, Yang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究沙棘黄酮IGRh及其代谢物通过SIR-2.1/DAF-16通路延缓线虫衰老，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是衰老表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside-7-O-rhamnoside (IGRh) is a characteristic flavonoid in sea buckthorn leaves, yet its anti-aging potential and underlying mechanisms remain largely unexplored. PURPOSE: This study aimed to systematically evaluate the anti-aging effects of IGRh and elucidate its mechanistic basis using Caenorhabditis elegans. METHODS: Lifespan, healthspan, stress resistance, and metabolic phenotypes were assessed in wild-type, mutant, and transgenic C. elegans strains. IGRh metabolites were profiled in vivo using UHPLC-QTOF-MS, and their interactions with SIR-2.1 were analyzed through molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. RESULTS: IGRh significantly extended lifespan and improved key aging-related phenotypes, including motility, intestinal barrier integrity, muscle structure, and lipid homeostasis, without impairing reproduction. IGRh also enhanced tolerance to heat and oxidative stress by elevating superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities and reducing reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels. Mechanistically, IGRh upregulated SIR-2.1 expression and promoted nuclear translocation of the transcription factors DAF-16 and HSF-1, thereby upregulating antioxidant and proteostasis-related genes. IGRh further stimulated the autophagy-lysosomal system and mitochondrial quality control, and its longevity-promoting effects were abolished in sir-2.1, daf-16, hlh-30, bec-1, clk-1, and mev-1 mutants. Metabolomic profiling revealed that IGRh was rapidly transformed into bioactive metabolites, including isorhamnetin, isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside (I3G), quercetin-3-O-glucoside (Q3G), protocatechuic acid, and vanillic acid, several of which persisted in vivo. Q3G showed the most favorable docking score and the highest structural stability within the SIR-2.1 binding pocket. Functional assays further demonstrated that Q3G significantly delayed aging and enhanced stress resistance in C. elegans in a sir-2.1-dependent manner. Together with the CETSA results, these findings support Q3G as a key candidate bioactive metabolite contributing to the SIR-2.1-dependent anti-aging effects of IGRh. CONCLUSION: IGRh and its metabolites delay aging in C. elegans by mediating SIR-2.1/DAF-16 signaling and modulating downstream IIS and autophagy-lysosomal pathways. These findings provide mechanistic insight into sea buckthorn leaf flavonoids and support their potential development as natural anti-aging interventions.
abstract_zh: 背景：异鼠李素-3-O-葡萄糖苷-7-O-鼠李糖苷（IGRh）是沙棘叶中的一种特征性黄酮类化合物，但其抗衰老潜力及潜在机制尚未得到充分探索。目的：本研究旨在利用秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）系统评估IGRh的抗衰老效应，并阐明其机制基础。方法：在野生型、突变体和转基因线虫品系中评估寿命、健康寿命、应激抵抗力和代谢表型。使用UHPLC-QTOF-MS在体内分析IGRh代谢物，并通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析其与SIR-2.1的相互作用。结果：IGRh显著延长寿命，并改善关键衰老相关表型，包括运动能力、肠道屏障完整性、肌肉结构和脂质稳态，且不损害生殖能力。IGRh还通过提高超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性，降低活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平，增强对热和氧化应激的耐受性。机制上，IGRh上调SIR-2.1表达，并促进转录因子DAF-16和HSF-1的核转位，从而上调抗氧化和蛋白质稳态相关基因。IGRh进一步刺激自噬-溶酶体系统和线粒体质量控制，其促长寿效应在sir-2.1、daf-16、hlh-30、bec-1、clk-1和mev-1突变体中消失。代谢组学分析显示，IGRh被快速转化为生物活性代谢物，包括异鼠李素、异鼠李素-3-O-葡萄糖苷（I3G）、槲皮素-3-O-葡萄糖苷（Q3G）、原儿茶酸和香草酸，其中若干在体内持续存在。Q3G在SIR-2.1结合口袋中显示出最有利的对接评分和最高的结构稳定性。功能实验进一步证明，Q3G以sir-2.1依赖性方式显著延缓线虫衰老并增强应激抵抗力。结合CETSA结果，这些发现支持Q3G作为关键候选生物活性代谢物，参与IGRh的SIR-2.1依赖性抗衰老效应。结论：IGRh及其代谢物通过介导SIR-2.1/DAF-16信号传导并调节下游IIS和自噬-溶酶体通路，延缓线虫衰老。这些发现为沙棘叶黄酮类化合物提供了机制性见解，并支持其作为天然抗衰老干预措施的潜在开发价值。
